description: A lab-local business logic flaw: the coupon endpoint accepts a discount code twice in one order, stacking a discount the business rules allow only once.

evidence.notes: Legitimate flow: one LAB10 per order, 10% off. Abused flow: the same code applied twice, 20% off — the endpoint never checks for a repeat code in the same order
evidence.request: POST https://lab.local/order/apply-coupon {code: "LAB10"} twice in one order

impact: An attacker could stack a one-time discount repeatedly and underpay for lab orders.
proof_of_concept: Applying LAB10 twice to one order yields 20% off, although the business rule allows it once per order (10%).
remediation: Record applied codes per order and reject a code that is already applied.
steps_to_reproduce: Apply coupon LAB10 once (10% off, as intended)
Apply LAB10 a second time to the same order
title: Business logic flaw in lab coupon handling
